info.name: Backblaze B2 Native Application Keys Authorization API
Backblaze B2 Native API Authorize Account

items.docs: Used to log in to the B2 API. Returns an authorization token that can be used for account-level operations. The authorization token is valid for at most 24 hours. This endpoint uses HTTP Basic authentication with the application key ID as the username and the application key as the password.

info.name: Backblaze B2 Native API Get Download Authorization

items.docs: Used to generate an authorization token that can be used to download files with the specified prefix from a private bucket.
